fields.paraphrase: The report identifies multiple named core-platform wins, multi-customer broker signings, and completed bank system go-lives during FY2018.
fields.scope: Core financial-software customer deployment or replacement only; no physical-capacity, production, or inventory carrier is used.

fields.paraphrase: AI-related offerings reached several customers, while cloud use remained constrained and blockchain remained at an exploratory stage; the report does not isolate repeat economics for these options.
fields.scope: AI, blockchain, and cloud option adoption only; product releases and broad internet revenue are not treated as repeat demand.

fields.paraphrase: FY2018 software revenue was RMB 3,186,775,619.54, up 23.62% year on year.
fields.scope: Consolidated reported software-product revenue; not attributed solely to core or new options.

fields.paraphrase: FY2018 software gross margin was 98.78%, 0.25 percentage point below the prior year.
fields.scope: Consolidated reported software-product gross margin.

fields.paraphrase: The annual report gives FY2018 revenue and year-on-year direction for all seven reported business lines.
fields.scope: Reported business-line perimeter; internet business is a broad line and is not treated as pure AI, blockchain, or cloud revenue.

fields.paraphrase: All FY2018 R&D input of RMB 1,404,668,841.96 was expensed and none was capitalized.
fields.scope: Consolidated FY2018 expensed R&D; already reflected in operating cash flow and not subtracted again.

fields.paraphrase: FY2018 R&D input equaled 43.05% of revenue.
fields.scope: Consolidated reported R&D-to-revenue ratio.

fields.paraphrase: The company reported 4,590 R&D staff, 64.45% of total employees.
fields.scope: Consolidated reported R&D personnel.

fields.paraphrase: FY2018 consolidated net cash from operating activities was RMB 937,082,661.39.
fields.scope: Consolidated statutory cash flow; expensed R&D is already included and is not deducted again.

fields.paraphrase: Consolidated cash paid to acquire or construct fixed assets, intangible assets, and other long-term assets was RMB 146,639,523.76.
fields.scope: All consolidated cash capex; no maintenance-versus-growth split is available.

fields.paraphrase: Inventory decrease of RMB 26,060,266.17 plus operating-receivable decrease of RMB 62,825,373.22 plus operating-payable increase of RMB 220,209,255.22 provided RMB 309,094,894.61 of cash support.
fields.scope: Consolidated cash-flow reconciliation components under the contract formula; no physical inventory metric is used as an operating-method carrier.

fields.paraphrase: FY2018 ending consolidated cash and cash equivalents were RMB 562,238,594.65.
fields.scope: Cash and cash equivalents; excludes RMB 4,265,586.50 of restricted guarantee deposits from the RMB 566,504,181.15 balance-sheet cash line.

fields.paraphrase: Year-end consolidated interest-bearing debt was RMB 60,000,000, entirely a current maturity of a long-term bank loan; short-term and long-term borrowing lines were nil.
fields.scope: Consolidated interest-bearing bank debt at FY2018 year end.

fields.paraphrase: Software sales and service advances were RMB 1,292,433,289.03; disclosed goods/material and expense payables added RMB 79,935,671.73.
fields.scope: Directly identified operating balances only; RMB 55,112,224.79 of long-term-asset purchase payables and non-operating other payables are excluded.

fields.paraphrase: The group paid RMB 455,075,000 to raise its stake in Hengyun Holdings while retaining control; the report identifies other strategic equity investments but does not disclose a complete non-overlapping cash amount for them.
fields.scope: Acquisition-equity and other external strategic cash only; financial cash-management principal, capex, and intra-group capital are excluded, and no unknown amount or causal attribution is invented.

fields.paraphrase: The report supplies comparable FY2017 business-line columns and separately discloses FY2018 consolidation additions, one disposal, and a minority-interest purchase without loss of control.
fields.scope: Measurement-comparability perimeter only; no operating causality is assigned to consolidation changes.

fields.paraphrase: Brokerage, asset management, wealth, exchange, and bank IT were each reported separately with FY2017 comparative revenue and direction.
fields.scope: Five core financial-IT business lines only.

fields.paraphrase: The report discloses multiple core-system wins and go-lives, including UF3.0, 17 broker signings, 14 BOP additions, and nearly 20 bank deployments, and does not identify a material core customer loss.
fields.scope: Core customer deployment, replacement, and explicitly disclosed loss only; absence of disclosure is not proof that no loss occurred.

fields.paraphrase: The report discusses named innovation subsidiaries and a broad internet-business line but does not isolate a comparable AI, blockchain, and cloud responsibility perimeter.
fields.scope: New-option responsibility boundary only; broad internet revenue and mixed subsidiary disclosures are not treated as pure option economics.

fields.paraphrase: The iSee intelligent product cooperated with three named securities firms, and the report describes application cases for several AI products.
fields.scope: Cross-customer deployment evidence only; it does not establish repeat revenue, maintenance revenue, or option profitability.

fields.paraphrase: Neither the broad internet-business line nor subsidiary disclosures isolate repeat or maintenance revenue for AI, blockchain, or cloud options.
fields.scope: Pure new-option repeat or maintenance revenue; releases, cases, customer lists, and broad internet revenue are excluded.

fields.paraphrase: Subsidiary tables provide mixed-scope net profit figures but do not disclose operating profit for a comparable AI, blockchain, or cloud option responsibility unit.
fields.scope: Pure new-option operating profit only; mixed subsidiary net profit is not substituted.

fields.paraphrase: Yunying Network reported declines in both new and renewal customers; the report gives no count, amount, or separate material discontinuation or impairment for the option scope.
fields.scope: Localized new-option customer weakness only; no magnitude, materiality, or group-level causality is inferred.

fields.paraphrase: All FY2018 R&D input of RMB 1,404,668,841.96 was expensed.

fields.paraphrase: The contract formula sums disclosed inventory, operating-receivable, and operating-payable cash-support components to RMB 309,094,894.61.
fields.scope: Consolidated cash-flow reconciliation only; no physical-capacity, production, or inventory operating carrier is introduced.

fields.paraphrase: FY2018 consolidated cash capex was RMB 146,639,523.76.

fields.paraphrase: RMB 937,082,661.39 of OCF less RMB 309,094,894.61 of working-capital cash support and RMB 146,639,523.76 of all capex leaves RMB 481,348,243.02.
fields.scope: One-period consolidated directional proxy, not core cash or normalized owner earnings; expensed R&D is not deducted again.

fields.paraphrase: The consolidated cash-flow line for cash paid to acquire subsidiaries net of acquired cash was nil, consistent with no business combination in FY2018.
fields.scope: Acquisition-of-control cash-flow line only; the RMB 455,075,000 purchase of an additional stake in an already controlled subsidiary is excluded here and kept in external strategic equity cash.

fields.paraphrase: The known non-overlapping external strategic outflow is the RMB 455,075,000 minority-interest purchase; other named strategic investments lack a complete cash disaggregation, so only their nonnegative outflow sign is retained.
fields.scope: External strategic cash excluding financial cash-management principal, capex, acquisition-of-control net cash, and intra-group capital; no unknown magnitude or causal attribution is supplied.

fields.paraphrase: After all capex, acquisition-of-control net cash, and the known minority-interest purchase, the residual cannot exceed RMB 26,273,243.02; undisclosed additional strategic outflow can reduce it, so the report does not establish a lower bound.
fields.scope: One-period consolidated funding residual bound only; it is not normalized owner cash, acquisition return, new-option causality, or proof of misallocation, and expensed R&D is not deducted again.
